bullets: On Friday 13 November, DLD recorded 290 sales worth AED 878m, which is 25.3% below a typical weekday.
Off-plan sales made up 56.2% of the market, compared to 55.1% over the last seven days.
The median price was AED 1,654 per sqft, down 0.8% over 30 days and 4.6% year-on-year.
JVC led the past week with 186 sales, followed by Dubai Land Residence with 125 and DAMAC Lagoons with 120.
In October new rental contracts, a JVC 1BR apartment had a median rent of AED 69,812 a year, rising 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: Brent crude is forecasted to ease to $78 by 2027, which influences regional economic liquidity and investor sentiment in real estate.
Emaar announced a $2bn branded residential pipeline in Abu Dhabi, altering the luxury residential landscape and housing supply.
Al Ain Asset Management and Emaar partnered for Dh8 billion projects, expanding regional housing supply and driving buyer interest.

items.headline: Global Stock Markets Slide on Tech Curbs and Fed Rate Fears
items.summary: Major international stock exchanges retreated due to strict US chip restrictions on China and anticipated Federal Reserve rate hikes.
items.why: This is general global stock market news with no direct local real estate impact.
items.impact_reason: No direct local real estate impact.

items.headline: Gold Prices Gain Slightly But Stay Near Lows
items.summary: Spot gold increased marginally while remaining near annual lows pressured by a strong dollar and expected rate hikes.
items.why: Precious metals pricing does not directly influence Dubai property transactions.

items.headline: UAE Launches First Property Black Friday Sale Event
items.summary: A new year-end promotional campaign offers property deals starting from AED 500 to boost market activity.
items.why: This promotional event directly impacts buyer sentiment and developer sales activity.
items.impact_reason: Boosts year-end sales and buyer engagement.

items.headline: Dubai Luxury Property Sales Reach $23.2bn
items.summary: High-end real estate transactions surged in Dubai, including thirteen ultra-luxury apartments selling above AED 100 million each.
items.why: Luxury sales figures indicate strong high-end market performance.

items.headline: ITAT Mumbai Rules in Favor of Taxpayer Over Husband Remittance
items.summary: An Indian tax tribunal cleared a taxpayer after her Dubai-based husband directly funded part of her property purchase.
items.why: This ruling affects cross-border remittance compliance for NRI property buyers.

items.headline: Alef Group Partners for 3D Advertising Screen at 06 Mall

items.headline: Brent Oil Slips on Rising Middle East Exports

items.headline: VIP PLUS Real Estate Trustee Office Partners With DefiPay

items.why: Partnerships involving DLD-authorised trustees impact transaction processes.

items.headline: Gold ranks as the top investment choice in the UAE
items.summary: A recent survey reveals gold is the most widely held asset among UAE investors. This trend highlights shifting investor preferences across local markets.

items.impact_reason: Shifts investor focus away from property.

items.headline: Savills appoints Jonathan Tagg in Abu Dhabi

items.why: Corporate personnel appointments do not impact market fundamentals.

items.headline: Emaar expands into Abu Dhabi luxury homes sector

items.headline: Hong Kong surpasses Dubai as top luxury housing market
items.summary: Hong Kong has overtaken Dubai to become the leading market for super-luxury homes. Analysts question whether this shift will be sustained.

items.impact_reason: Global ranking change without direct local policy shifts.

items.headline: Binghatti and Loft & Keys expand Dubai property access
items.summary: Binghatti and Loft & Keys are working to broaden market access in Kano. This initiative connects international buyers with Dubai real estate.
items.why: It opens new international demand channels for Dubai properties.
items.impact_reason: Drives foreign buyer demand into Dubai.
